reviewer.notes: Fresh-context independent review (C5 wave, 2026-08-21). Falsification attempt: I tried to find a counter-example by validating the delivered artifact against its DECLARED output schema from the work-unit catalog, rather than trusting narrative text. Unit BLD-0001 at command-center/receipts/BLD-0001.json declares output_schema='command-center/schema/blindspot-register.schema.json'; schema_errors=0. I also cross-checked the catalog reviewer requirement for vendor eligibility (required reviewer_vendor=any). Catalog reviewer_requirement (verbatim, normalized whitespace): One independent reviewer who re-derives the unread count with a mechanically different extractor (jq over the JSONL rather than the Python parser) and must agree within 1% or the discrepancy blocks.
